body:
```suggestion
	inline static UIDUpgradeTool *singleton = nullptr;
```
This syntax is preferred nowadays.

Note that UIDUpgradeTool is Object, so it will leak if you don't memdelete it.
I guess that's the reason to have `uid_upgrade_tool` variable? Although you can memdelete singleton as well, so not sure why the variable exists.

```suggestion
	Vector<String> resave_paths = EditorSettings::get_singleton()->get_project_metadata("uid_upgrade_tool", "resave_paths", Variant());
```
This should remove the variable. No reason to store empty array.
I see I missed the `memdelete` for `surface_upgrade_tool` when I was working on this - I'll add it soon!
